title: Rami son of Rav Yud
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Taanit 22b: “Rami son of Rav Yud said: And in the Diaspora one sounds the alarm for it.” Rashi explains: a sage whose name was Yud.

In Pesachim 62b: “Rami son of Rav Yuda said that Rav said: From the day the Book of Genealogies was hidden away, the strength of the sages has weakened.” In Zevachim 55b: “Rami son of Rav Yehudah (Rav Yud, Dikdukei Soferim) said that Rav said: There was a small opening,” etc.

notes.text: Taanit 22b directly names Rami bar Rav Yud. The exact Dikdukei Soferim reading at Zevachim 55b has not been independently inspected; the Yud/Yuda/Yehudah forms remain as Hyman reports them.
